clauses.clause: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
If it's a Zombie card, draw a card.

mapping.notes: M20 Disentomb's verified return, then Track Down's 'If it's a ... card, draw a card.' Conditional (judged on the returned card) with SUBTYPE_EQ Zombie. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: cemetery_recruitment_non_zombie_draws_nothing, cemetery_recruitment_zombie_draws_one.
